# Buying in SeaFlower

> Everything buyers ask about SeaFlower in Bradenton, FL: builders, floor plans, pricing, HOA and CDD fees, location, schools, flood zones and the buying process, from a former builder insider who represents buyers.

Published by Trenton Miller (Found Your Florida, LPT Realty, LLC), a buyer's agent and former builder insider (seven years with Pulte/Del Webb and David Weekley Homes, including operations at David Weekley where he briefly oversaw SeaFlower). Contact: 716-949-5557, trenton@foundyourflorida.com. This site is independent and not affiliated with SeaFlower's developer or any builder. Data is dated on each page; last site-wide update September 3, 2026.

## Core guides
- [SeaFlower Bradenton Buyer's Guide: Builders, Prices, HOA and CDD Fees (2026)](https://buyinginseaflower.com/): The independent guide to buying in SeaFlower, Bradenton FL: all five builders compared, 60+ floor plans and prices, HOA and Lake Flores CDD fees, location, videos and 60+ buyer questions, from a former David Weekley operations manager who now represents buyers.
- [SeaFlower Bradenton Community Guide: Master Plan, Amenities, Village Center and Rules](https://buyinginseaflower.com/community/): What SeaFlower in Bradenton actually is: 1,175 acres, 1,063 Phase One homes, The Garden Club opening fall 2026, the Lake Flores golf-cart trail, the Publix-anchored Village Center, plus rules on gates, golf carts, ADUs and rentals. Verified Sept 2026.
- [SeaFlower Location: Distance to Anna Maria Island, Schools, Airports, Flood Zone and Drive Times](https://buyinginseaflower.com/location/): SeaFlower is in west Bradenton 34210, 3.2 miles from the beach, 18 minutes from SRQ and 65 from Tampa. Drive times to beaches, hospitals and shopping, zoned schools (Sea Breeze, Sugg or Electa Lee, Bayshore), the FEMA flood zone, evacuation levels and the honest Cortez Road traffic note.
- [SeaFlower Floor Plans and Prices: 62 Plans and 35 Quick Move-Ins Compared (Sept 2026)](https://buyinginseaflower.com/homes/): Every SeaFlower floor plan from M/I, Pulte, David Weekley, Cardel and Issa in one sortable table: square footage, beds, baths, garage and base price as published, plus 35 quick move-in homes and what base price leaves out.
- [SeaFlower HOA Fees, Lake Flores CDD, Taxes and Insurance: The Real Monthly Cost](https://buyinginseaflower.com/costs/): SeaFlower's HOA is $300.88 a month for single-family homes and includes fiber and yard care; the Lake Flores CDD runs about $1,475 to $4,605 a year by phase and lot width. Worked monthly examples, official CDD tables, tax and insurance math, verified Sept 2026.
- [SeaFlower Bradenton FAQ: 79 Buyer Questions on HOA, CDD, Builders, Flood Zone and More](https://buyinginseaflower.com/faq/): 79 straight answers about buying in SeaFlower, Bradenton: HOA and CDD fees, builders and prices, flood zone and evacuation level, golf carts, ADUs and rentals, schools, incentives, deposits and contracts. Sourced and dated, with insider perspective from a former builder operations manager.
- [SeaFlower Videos: Builder Tours, Community Q&A and Buying Tips](https://buyinginseaflower.com/videos/): Watch Trenton Miller's SeaFlower Bradenton videos: every builder toured, the community leadership interviewed, plus short answers on HOA and CDD fees, incentives, contracts and relocating to Florida's Gulf Coast.

## Builders
- [SeaFlower Builders Compared: M/I, Pulte, David Weekley, Cardel and Issa Homes (Sept 2026)](https://buyinginseaflower.com/builders/): All five SeaFlower builders side by side: products, lot widths, square footage, starting prices as each builder phrases them, sales offices and phones, plus how to choose between them from a former Pulte and David Weekley insider.
- [M/I Homes at SeaFlower: Plans, Prices, Lot Sizes and Incentives (Sept 2026)](https://buyinginseaflower.com/builders/mi-homes/): M/I Homes at SeaFlower, Bradenton: Priced from: $399,999. 5 floor plans, 1,486–2,406 sq ft, 21 quick move-ins, model address, fees as quoted, incentives and watch-outs from a former builder insider.
- [Pulte Homes at SeaFlower: Plans, Prices, Lot Sizes and Incentives (Sept 2026)](https://buyinginseaflower.com/builders/pulte-homes/): Pulte Homes at SeaFlower, Bradenton: $404,990+. 13 floor plans, 1,405–2,369 sq ft, 6 quick move-ins, model address, fees as quoted, incentives and watch-outs from a former builder insider.
- [David Weekley Homes at SeaFlower: Plans, Prices, Lot Sizes and Incentives (Sept 2026)](https://buyinginseaflower.com/builders/david-weekley-homes/): David Weekley Homes at SeaFlower, Bradenton: From the $500s. 12 floor plans, 1,615–3,777 sq ft, 4 quick move-ins, model address, fees as quoted, incentives and watch-outs from a former builder insider.
- [Cardel Homes at SeaFlower: Plans, Prices, Lot Sizes and Incentives (Sept 2026)](https://buyinginseaflower.com/builders/cardel-homes/): Cardel Homes at SeaFlower, Bradenton: From the $500s. 19 floor plans, 1,900–3,172 sq ft, 2 quick move-ins, model address, fees as quoted, incentives and watch-outs from a former builder insider.
- [Issa Homes at SeaFlower: Plans, Prices, Lot Sizes and Incentives (Sept 2026)](https://buyinginseaflower.com/builders/issa-homes/): Issa Homes at SeaFlower, Bradenton: Estate Homes starting from $1,250,000, excluding homesite premium. 13 floor plans, 2,905–3,755 sq ft, 2 quick move-ins, model address, fees as quoted, incentives and watch-outs from a former builder insider.

- [SeaFlower Blog: Fees, Builders, Contracts, Comparisons and Market Updates](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/): Long-form answers about buying in SeaFlower, Bradenton: HOA and CDD fees explained, builder deep dives, flood zone facts, SeaFlower vs Lakewood Ranch, incentives, quick move-ins and monthly market updates from a former builder insider.
- [SeaFlower HOA fees explained: what $300.88 a month actually covers, by home type](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/seaflower-hoa-fees-explained/): The official numbers, what is inside them, why the internet shows five different figures, and the one thing that will change after The Garden Club opens.
- [Lake Flores CDD: the official per-lot assessment table and what it means for your tax bill](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/lake-flores-cdd-assessments-explained/): The district's own FY2027 numbers by phase and lot width, why Phase 1C costs more, and the answer to 'are CDD fees forever?'
- [David Weekley at SeaFlower: Bungalow vs Classic, from a former Weekley operations manager](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/david-weekley-bungalow-vs-classic-seaflower/): Twelve plans on two lot sizes, what each collection is really for, and what I checked on these homes when signing them off was my job.
- [Is SeaFlower in a flood zone? FEMA zone, evacuation level and what insurance really costs](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/is-seaflower-in-a-flood-zone/): What FEMA's map actually shows for the site, why the flood zone and the evacuation level are different questions, and the three documents to demand for your lot.
- [SeaFlower vs Lakewood Ranch: fees, commute, beach distance and what you are really choosing](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/seaflower-vs-lakewood-ranch/): I have sold in both. One is finished infrastructure an hour from the sand; the other is the beach side of the county with the amenity center still under construction.
- [Do you need a buyer's agent for new construction in Bradenton? What the sales counselor won't tell you](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/do-you-need-a-buyers-agent-for-new-construction/): The on-site consultant is good at the job, and the job is selling the builder's homes. What representation actually does, what it costs, and the registration rule that trips people up.
- [Quick move-in or to-be-built at SeaFlower: which is the better deal right now](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/quick-move-in-vs-to-be-built-seaflower/): Finished inventory carries the discounts and rate buydowns. To-be-built gets you the lot. How to decide, with the September 2026 numbers.
- [The honest pros and cons of buying in SeaFlower](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/honest-pros-and-cons-of-buying-in-seaflower/): Traffic, density, CDD debt, construction years and one pool for the first phase, weighed against the beach, the design and the sales pace.
- [SeaFlower construction timeline: Garden Club, Publix, Village Center, apartments, hotel and Phase Two](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/seaflower-construction-timeline/): A living page of what is built, what is under construction and what is promised, with dates as published. Updated as milestones land.
- [How builder incentives really work at SeaFlower, and how to stack them](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/how-builder-incentives-work-at-seaflower/): Rate buydowns, closing-cost credits, design credits and lot premiums: the mechanics, the September 2026 offers by builder, and the order to ask in.
- [Moving to west Bradenton: living three miles from Anna Maria Island](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/moving-to-west-bradenton/): What this side of the county is like, the homestead calendar that decides your first tax bill, and the things I tell every relocating buyer from Buffalo.
- [SeaFlower market update, September 2026: sales pace, inventory, incentives and what opens next](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/seaflower-market-update-september-2026/): The first full year in numbers, what is listed right now by builder, what builders are offering, and what I am watching this fall.
- [M/I Homes at SeaFlower: townhomes and villas from $399,999, what's included and what to watch](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/mi-homes-townhomes-villas-seaflower/): The only attached product in SeaFlower: 68 townhomes and 90 twin villas, five plans, a lock-and-leave HOA, and the biggest quick move-in inventory in the community.
- [Pulte Homes at SeaFlower: Scenic, Veranda, Front Porch and Distinctive series explained](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/pulte-homes-seaflower-series-explained/): Thirteen plans from $404,990 to $641,990, which series has the ADU option, how Pulte's incentives work, and what a former Pulte top producer would tell you.
- [Cardel Homes at SeaFlower: all 19 plans, 50' vs 60' lots, garage suites and natural gas](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/cardel-homes-seaflower-all-19-plans/): Cardel's Cottage and Classic collections in front-garage and rear-garage versions, base prices from $579,990, the garage-suite option, and what a full model tour showed me.
- [Issa Homes at SeaFlower: lakefront estate homes from $1.25 million, and what that price leaves out](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/issa-homes-estate-homes-seaflower/): The Lakeshore and Preserve collections on 80-foot lots, the homesite premium that is only quoted on request, the Parade-winning Hemingway, and the two homes listed above $1.5 million.
- [Which schools are SeaFlower homes zoned for? Sea Breeze, Sugg or Electa Lee, and Bayshore](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/seaflower-schools-zoned/): What the builders list, where they disagree, the third-party ratings, the private and magnet options nearby, and how to confirm a specific address.
- [Golf carts at SeaFlower: where you can drive, what Florida law allows, and getting to the beach](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/golf-carts-at-seaflower/): The 2.5-mile multi-modal trail, the difference between a golf cart and a street-legal LSV, the rules on public streets, and the honest answer about Cortez Road.
- [ADUs and garage apartments at SeaFlower: which builders offer them, the rental rules, and the math](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/adus-garage-apartments-seaflower/): Why every single-family lot here can have an accessory dwelling unit, what Cardel, Pulte, Issa and David Weekley offer, the one-year owner-occupancy rule, and how to think about rental income.
- [SeaFlower site plan explained: phases N1, 1B1, 1B2 and 1C, lot widths, and where each product sits](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/seaflower-site-plan-phases-explained/): The 1,063 Phase One homesites by phase and product, why the phase matters for your CDD bill, how lots are released, and what Phase Two means.
- [SeaFlower vs Wellen Park vs Parrish: which Gulf Coast new-construction market fits you](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/seaflower-vs-wellen-park-vs-parrish/): The three places I tour most with relocating buyers, compared on beach distance, price, stage of buildout, and who each one is really for.
- [What a SeaFlower home costs per month at three budgets: $410K, $486K and $700K](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/seaflower-monthly-cost-three-budgets/): Three real product types with the builders' own prices and the district's own assessment tables, all the way down to a monthly number.
- [New-construction inspections at SeaFlower: pre-drywall, blue tape and the 11-month walk](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/new-construction-inspections-seaflower/): What an independent inspector checks at each stage of a build, what I looked for when signing off homes for David Weekley, and why a new home still needs one.
- [The SeaFlower Village Center: Publix, the tenant list, apartments, the hotel and the opening timeline](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/seaflower-village-center-publix/): What CASTO and Redstone are building on 47 acres at Cortez Road and 75th Street, who has signed, and what opens when.
- [The Garden Club at SeaFlower: what is inside the amenity center and when it opens](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/the-garden-club-seaflower-amenity-center/): Plumeria Hall, the Gathering Hall, the fitness center, the resort pool, four pickleball courts, the event lawn, and the HOA fee change that comes with opening day.
- [Homestead exemption and the property-tax timeline on a new SeaFlower home](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/homestead-exemption-new-construction-manatee/): Why the first tax bill is small and the second is not, the January 1 and March 1 deadlines, what to file with the Manatee County Property Appraiser, and portability.
- [Homeowners insurance on a new SeaFlower home: wind mitigation, impact glass and the Zone X flood policy](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/insurance-on-a-new-seaflower-home/): Why new construction three miles from the Gulf insures for less than the headlines suggest, which credits Florida requires insurers to give, and what to do before contract.
- [How to read a Florida new-construction contract: the eight clauses that decide your deal](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/how-to-read-a-florida-new-construction-contract/): Builder contracts are written by the builder's lawyers, not the standard Florida form. These are the paragraphs I read first with every SeaFlower client.
- [Design center strategy at SeaFlower: what to buy from the builder and what to do after closing](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/design-center-strategy-seaflower/): Where the design budget actually goes, what must be done before the slab, what the builder marks up, and the spending rule I give every client.
- [Lot premiums at SeaFlower: what drives them, how much they run, and when they are negotiable](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/lot-premiums-at-seaflower/): Why the same plan costs tens of thousands more across the street, how premiums are set and raised, and the lots where builders will move.
- [Buying a SeaFlower home from out of state: the plan from twelve months out to closing day](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/buying-seaflower-from-out-of-state/): Remote tours, one well-planned visit, contract review from a distance, video walkthroughs during the build, and a remote closing under Florida law.
- [Buying a second home or seasonal home at SeaFlower: lock-and-leave product, HOA coverage and taxes](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/second-home-seasonal-buying-seaflower/): Which SeaFlower homes are built to be left for months, what the HOA takes care of while you are away, and how taxes and insurance differ without a homestead.
- [SeaFlower rental rules: whole-home leasing, ADU leases, the apartments, and what the HOA documents govern](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/seaflower-rental-rules/): What is published, what is only claimed, what Florida law lets an HOA restrict, and how to verify before you buy as an investor.
- [What SeaFlower's RCLCO ranking actually means: first-year sales in context](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/what-the-rclco-ranking-means-for-seaflower/): 198 contracts in the first half of 2026, tied for 51st in the country and 17th in Florida, compared with Lakewood Ranch and Wellen Park, and why it matters to a buyer.
- [The history of SeaFlower: from the Preston gladiolus farm to Lake Flores to a coastal village](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/history-of-seaflower-preston-farm-lake-flores/): Ninety years of flowers, a 2015 approval, three names, and the family and developers behind the largest new community on Bradenton's coastal mainland.
- [Hurricane preparedness for a new SeaFlower home: code, evacuation levels, generators and a plan](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/hurricane-preparedness-new-seaflower-home/): What the current Florida Building Code gives you, how to find your evacuation level, what a natural-gas generator setup looks like, and the checklist for a storm week.
- [Rear-load vs front-load lots at SeaFlower: yards, pools, alleys and daily life](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/rear-load-vs-front-load-lots-seaflower/): Which builders offer which, what an alley garage changes about your lot, and the questions to ask before you choose.
- [Natural gas at SeaFlower: what it means for cooking, hot water, generators and your builder choice](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/natural-gas-at-seaflower/): TECO Peoples Gas serves the community. Which builders make it standard, what to stub before the slab, and the cost logic.
- [Builder warranties at SeaFlower explained: 1-2-10, what is covered, and how to use yours](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/builder-warranties-explained-1-2-10/): What each builder publishes, what the years actually mean, what is excluded, whether it transfers, and the eleven-month walk that protects you.
- [Can you negotiate with a builder in SeaFlower? What moved in 2026 and what did not](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/can-you-negotiate-with-a-builder-in-seaflower/): Public evidence of price cuts and credits, the numbers that never move, and the order and timing that get results.
- [How builder sales really works: what the on-site consultant can and cannot do for you](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/how-builder-sales-really-works/): Quotas, registration, the approval chain, the lender tie-in and quarter-end, from someone who sat at that desk for six years.
- [Manatee County growth and what it means for SeaFlower: population, infrastructure and the west side](https://buyinginseaflower.com/blog/manatee-county-growth-and-seaflower/): The county grew 23% in a decade and 10% more since 2020, nearly all of it east of I-75. SeaFlower is the exception, and that is the point.
